key_concepts: A mutation is a change in the DNA sequence
Mutations can arise from DNA copying errors or environmental factors such as UV light and
Mutagens are agents that alter DNA, including radiation and certain chemicals
Mutation occurs during DNA replication and can make transcription anomalous
Point mutation affects a single nucleotide base
Substitution mutations include silent, missense, and nonsense types
Nonsense mutation creates a premature stop codon and shortens the protein
Missense mutation changes a codon to specify a different amino acid
Frameshift mutation can result from inserting or deleting a nucleotide
Stop codons signal the end of translation
mRNA codons are translated into amino acids during protein synthesis
